current_runtime_gap.behavior: A retrieved hit is called repeat at similarity >= 0.78 with the same topic and absolute creation-time distance <= 30 days.
missing_evidence: confirmed resolution of previous episode before query

required_integration.before_approval: Do not present an unverified candidate as REPEAT; retain it as SIMILAR and allow operator relation feedback.
required_integration.after_approval: Load an approved versioned relation policy and a verified prior-resolution signal. Apply chronological and semantic checks before presenting REPEAT; preserve operator confirmation as a separate decision.
do_not: infer verified resolution from ticket status or closed_at alone

acceptance_evidence: reviewed validation and frozen-test relation pairs include REPEAT and hard negatives
approved temporal source and review checksums match the evaluated package
separate repeat window report meets precommitted support and precision policy
runtime evidence source and policy version are recorded
runtime tests reject future candidates and unresolved previous episodes
